securityAcceptance: Source/build-surface review completed for the bounded restricted worker on 2026-11-02. The private test rollout requires all Media Video checks. General production activation remains an explicit operator rollout, default off.

CVE-2025-52290.review: Upstream range remains undetermined. The published reporter describes an AAC allocation misinterpreted by the H.264 helper after a failed codec switch. The pinned helper only guarded null private data/SPS; guard-h264-context.patch now checks the actual allocated decoder and requested codec before reading private state. The build executes test-h264-context.c with an AAC decoder, H.264 codec ID and inaccessible private pointer, plus null and uninitialized H.264 cases. MPEG-TS is also absent and input is forced MOV. This is a reviewed local defense for the shipped surface, not a claim that upstream marks the CVE resolved.
